name: MessageActions
usage: Copy, retry and rate an AI reply; actions of a chat message

props.name: copyText
props.description:
The text copied by the "Copy" button, usually the plain text or Markdown source of the message. The button is
shown only when it is set.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the text has been written to the clipboard.

props.name: onCopyError
props.description: Called when copying fails (see CopyButton); without it the error is reported with `reportError`.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a "Retry" button that calls this function, for example to generate the reply again.

props.name: feedback
props.description: The current feedback (controlled). Without it the buttons keep their own state, starting with none.

props.name: onFeedbackChange
props.description:
Shows the "Like" and "Dislike" toggle buttons; called with the new feedback. Pressing the pressed button again
clears it (`null`); the two buttons exclude each other.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the toolbar; "Message actions" by default.

props.name: children
props.description:
Your own actions after the built-in ones, usually IconButton with `size="sm"`. They take part in the arrow key
navigation.

types.name: MessageFeedback
types.summary: Feedback on a message: `like`, `dislike`, or `null` for none.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Copy, retry, like and dislike. Like and dislike exclude each other, and pressing the pressed one again clears
it. The group has one `Tab` stop; `←` / `→` move between the buttons.

examples.name: CustomActions
examples.title: Your own actions
examples.description: Icon buttons passed as children come after the built-in ones and take part in the arrow key navigation.
